question: Who among the following received the 2024 Padma Bhushan award for Literature and Education-Journalism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hormusji N Cama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hormusji N Cama is a renowned figure in the field of Literature and Education-Journalism.
 
• He has been honored with the prestigious Padma Bhushan award in the year 2024.
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished service of a high order.
 
• Hormusji N Cama has significantly contributed to the field of journalism, particularly in promoting ethical journalism and media integrity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Padma Awards**

 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, instituted in 1954.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• These awards are announced annually on the occasion of Republic Day.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service, the Padma Bhushan for distinguished service of a high order, and the Padma Shri for distinguished service in any field.
 
 
 
• **Ethical Journalism**
 
 
• Ethical journalism involves maintaining integrity, impartiality, and fairness in reporting news.
 
• It emphasizes the importance of accuracy, verification, and accountability.
 
• Journalists are expected to avoid conflicts of interest and to respect the privacy and dignity of individuals.
 
• Promoting ethical journalism helps in building public trust and ensuring the credibility of media organizations.
 
 
 
• **Media Integrity**
 
 
• Media integrity refers to the ethical standards and professional conduct of journalists and media organizations.
 
• It involves transparency, unbiased reporting, and accountability to the public.
 
• Maintaining media integrity is crucial for preserving the democratic function of the press as a watchdog.
 
• Efforts to ensure media integrity include self-regulation, adherence to journalistic codes of conduct, and independent oversight bodies.
